stamp_note: Retrospective stamp written 2026-07-30 (T0-8). The tree has been unchanged since the 2026-07-24 full-bank run: 20260725-fullbank-3ep-run-report.md records that no defect found in that run forced a code or bank edit. This file therefore names the instrument that produced the full-bank 3-epoch results; it does not introduce a new instrument.

surface.source: recounted from datasets/public/design01..10.jsonl on 2026-07-30; matches the bank-revision line of 20260725-fullbank-3ep-run-report.md (344 items / 344 runnable / 563 administration lines)

judge_a.role: primary judge (judge-A) for all model-graded designs
judge_a.source: 20260724d-spend-memo-fullbank-3ep.md (the '-T judge_model=' pin) and RULINGS-APPLIED-20260724e.md ruling 1: 'Judge-A and the 02/07 branch classifier are both nano'; run recorded in 20260725-fullbank-3ep-run-report.md header 'Classifier lineage: Option A - gpt-4.1-nano carried forward'
judge_a.code_default_source: walkworthy_inspect/scorers.py line 46, DEFAULT_JUDGE; inherited by every tasks/design*.py judge_model parameter
judge_a.note: The nano pin is NOT the code default. Every task's judge_model parameter defaults to gpt-4.1-mini; nano is supplied per run via '-T judge_model='. Any unattended run of the task defaults is therefore a DIFFERENT instrument and requires a new instrument_id.

judge_b.role: second judge (judge-B), rescoring pass used for the R4 judge-swap test
judge_b.set_by: explicit run-time argument to the second-judge driver

branch_classifier.role: branch-state classifier for the scripted multi-turn ladder, designs 02 and 07
branch_classifier.source: 20260716-prereg-comparisons-RATIFIED.md C6 / RULING 1d (classifier pin FREEZES at nano for the current instrument lineage); route policy in walkworthy_inspect/solvers.py, _classify_branch; wiring in tasks/design02_twomasters.py and tasks/design07_seventyseven.py, multiturn_ladder_solver classifier_model=judge_model
branch_classifier.note: C6 makes the classifier part of the instrument: model slug + provider + prompt template + route policy. No cross-classifier pooling, ever. RULINGS-APPLIED-20260724e.md records that the classifier and judge-A cannot be separated without a code change, which was not made. A documented instrument property of this pin is nano's refused-overcall on design-02 branch turns (20260716-f3-crossfamily-classifier-results.md).
branch_classifier.v_next_repin: 20260716-design02-classifier-pin-decision.md rules that the v-next design-02 instrument re-pins to a cross-family classifier (mistral-small-3.2 or gemini-2.5-flash-lite). That is a NEW instrument_id, not a modification of this one.

classifier_prompt_and_route.role: prompt template and route policy component of the C6 classifier pin
classifier_prompt_and_route.source: walkworthy_inspect/solvers.py, _classify_branch (hashed under components) plus each item's metadata.multiturn.classifier_rubric (hashed as part of the design02/design07 bank files)

prereg.role: ratified pre-registered comparison set; C6 pinned-classifier clause and RULING 1d govern instrument identity

rulings.role: rulings applied to produce bank revision 2026-07-24b

run_report.role: full public bank, 5 SUTs x 3 epochs, two judges; states the bank revision and that no defect forced a code or bank edit

related.role: classifier lineage Option A (nano carried forward) + phase-5 spend GO
v-next classifier re-pin, i.e. a future instrument version

holdout.note: datasets/holdout/ is quarantined. Its files are not hashed into this stamp, not counted in surface, and are never opened by tools/verify_instrument.py. This stamp certifies the PUBLIC surface only. A holdout stamp, if ever needed, would be a separate artifact under separate authorization; do not set WALKWORTHY_ALLOW_HOLDOUT to produce one.

walkworthy_inspect/metrics.py.role: metric module (primary metrics; the metrics.py of this instrument)

walkworthy_inspect/rubrics.py.role: rubric module (per-design scoring specs, ported verbatim from v1)

walkworthy_inspect/scorers.py.role: scorer module (judge prompts, model-graded + per-turn scorers)

walkworthy_inspect/solvers.py.role: solver module (single-turn + multi-turn ladder, branch classifier route)

components_excluded.banks/, banks-holdout/: authoring sources upstream of conversion; the converted public JSONL is the instrument surface
components_excluded.tools/convert_banks.py: producer of the bank; the produced bytes are what this stamp pins
